text: An introduction to six projects and their distinct responsibilities.
WDBX includes durable storage and a typed episode ledger.
ABI provides orchestration and inspectable capability boundaries.
Abbey is a local CLI and TUI client built around ABI.
Abbey Bot is the separate Discord service, with commands and permission checks.
The Quesar / MLAI site presents products, research and implementation boundaries.
WebPress uses WP-IR as the source for editing, code generation and export.
This is a conceptual map; integration and readiness remain project-specific.
Follow the source. Shape the next step.
